title: Periodica 3D v4.5.2 - Interactive Gesture Zoom & Multi-View Experience Update
changelog: Pinch-to-Zoom & Pan on Electron & Isotope Tables: Full multi-touch gesture zoom (0.75x to 3.5x), smooth 1-finger panning with boundary clamping, and double-tap reset across Electron Configurations and Radioactive Isotopes views
Interactive FitBox Floating Widget: Visual zoom percentage pill with instant reset button on all periodic grid tables
Full-Screen Molecular 3D Suite: Edge-to-edge inspection suite displaying detailed 3D ball-and-stick structures, physical properties, and chemistry definitions side-by-side with enlarged typography
Atom-Colored Mass % Line: High-contrast thick composition bar filled with atom CPK colors representing exact stoichiometric mass weight percentages
Native Rotation & Layout Stability: Zero top bar gap alignment and preserved natural sensor orientation across mobile devices
